title: Eco-engineered electrospun La/Rb-MOF/chitosan–PCL nanofibrous membrane for high-performance, recyclable, and sustainable Cr(VI) removal from water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44766-44796
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06962A, Paper

This research develops a novel electrospun nanofibrous membrane combining chitosan, polycaprolactone, and a bimetallic La/Rb-MOF for effective Cr(VI) extraction from water.
